trigger: Daily check finds Stripe events not delivered (billing.js webhookHealth)
subject: Stripe webhooks failing: {{count}} {{events_word}} not delivered
preheader: Plan changes and payments may not show on accounts.
footer_note: Sent to ALERT_TO (or CONTACT_TO) by the daily billing check, at most once a day.
body: Stripe could not deliver {{count}} {{events_word}} to {{webhook_url}} in the last day ({{mode}} mode), between {{first}} and {{last}}.
Stripe keeps retrying for three days. Until delivery works, plan changes, payments and failed payments may not show on customers' accounts.

body.small: Check: Stripe dashboard > Developers > Webhooks > the endpoint > failed deliveries (the response code says why); that STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the Worker matches the endpoint's signing secret; the Worker's logs.
